{{Quote|Serv-O-Droid -- modular automatons for a less-than-modular galaxy.|Advertisement during ''[[Ugnaughts' Progress]]'', an ''[[Action Tidings]]'' Special Report|<ref name="Bespin: Action Tidings">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040930bespinmain|text=Bespin: Action Tidings|int=Bespin: Action Tidings}}</ref>}}
'''Serv-O-Droid, Inc.''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturer owned by the [[Delban Serv-O-Droid]] conglomerate.
They once owned a construction plant in the [[Grungeon Block]] of [[The Works/Legends|the Works]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==History==
{{Quote|Serv-O-Droid -- Shouldn't your droid be serving you?|Advertisement during ''[[Ugnaughts' Progress]]'', an ''[[Action Tidings]]'' Special Report|<ref name="Bespin: Action Tidings" />}}
[[File:Pit_Droids_EV.png|thumb|left|180px|Pit droids were an inexpensive model of labor droid common throughout the galaxy]]
Serv-O-Droid was one of the oldest manufacturers of droids, and some legends suggested that it was one of the first.<ref name="G3:50" /> Dating to the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], Serv-O-Droid became a household name with the cheap and extremely reliable [[R-8009 utility droid]], which brought the company billions of credits and enabled it to swallow its chief competitor, [[Delban Faxicorp|Delban Electrodyne]], forming the [[Delban Serv-O-Droid]] conglomerate.

Though Serv-O-Droid never reached the level of [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] or [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]], the company established itself firmly in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for thousands of years, until it eventually bankrupted with the establishment of the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. They were one of the [[contributing sponsor]]s of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] but went out of business shortly after its formation and the signing of its charter.<ref name="HSCS" />

It made some bad decisions to ally itself with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] bureaucracy. While this led to many favorable deals, the bribes, kickbacks, and political favors eventually dragged the company down. It attempted to expand its offerings, but eventually went bankrupt. Many of its designs and manufacturing was sold to the [[Droid ReServe]], a droid remainder reseller located on [[Elshandruu Pica]]. They continued to sell and service Serv-O-Droid models for many years.<ref name="Scavenger's Guide to Droids">''[[Scavenger's Guide to Droids]]''</ref> Despite its troubled business dealings, Serv-O-Droid maintained a reputation for high quality until it went out of business prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="G3:50" />
